user.title: Tidy Rooms
user.description: Choose the robot vacuum. Then add each room from the integration page.

data.wake_minutes: Minutes of presence to count as awake
data.start_timeout: Minutes to wait for the robot to start before retrying
data.job_done_delay: Minutes docked before a job counts as done

data_description.quiet_start: The robot never starts between these two times, not even for a forced pass; passes without a start time start at the end.
data_description.wake_sensors: On the selected days, cleaning starts only after one of these sensors has detected someone for the given minutes (for example breakfast in the kitchen). Leave empty to skip the check.
data_description.work_mode_entity: A select entity of the robot with its work modes (vacuum, mop, …): each pass of a program chooses one.
data_description.job_done_delay: Used only without a cleaning job sensor. Robots that wash the mop go back to the dock during a job: the job counts as done only after the robot stays docked this long. A return to recharge also counts as the end.
data_description.battery_entity: For robots that report the battery in a separate sensor.
data_description.finished_event: An event entity of the robot that fires when a job ends. Event types finished and finished_with_warnings mark the job as done right away; other types mark it as stopped.
data_description.job_entity: A binary sensor of the robot that is on from the start to the end of a cleaning job, also while the robot is at the dock in the middle of it. When set, it decides when a job is over, and a job started elsewhere (app, schedule) keeps the robot busy.

robot.title: Robot settings

data.normal_fan_speed: Fan speed of the passes without their own
data.quiet_fan_speed: Fan speed while someone is in the room
data.restore_settings: Put the robot's settings back after each job

data_description.quiet_fan_speed: Used only when a room must be cleaned after its deadline while someone is there.
data_description.restore_settings: At the end of Tidy Rooms' jobs, the robot gets back the work mode and fan speed it had before (a cleaning started from its app would otherwise inherit them). A setting changed by someone else in the meantime is left as it is.

robot.description: Each menu offers all the options of the robot. Each pass of a room's program can use its own fan speed.

error.area_already_configured: This area already has a room.
error.proxy_with_occupancy: Use either the room's own sensors or the sensors of other rooms, not both.

user.title: Add room
user.description: The area must be mapped to the robot's rooms (vacuum entity settings, "Areas"). The cleaning program of the room (its passes) is set in the Tidy Rooms panel: a new room has none.

data_description.proxy_sensors: For rooms without their own sensor: the room counts as free while one of these sensors detects someone elsewhere.
data_description.clean_action: Replaces the standard area cleaning, for robots whose integration does not support it. Variables: room, area_id, work_mode, pass_id, quiet, vacuum_entity.

data_description.proxy_sensors: For rooms without their own sensor: the room counts as free while one of these sensors detects someone elsewhere.
data_description.clean_action: Replaces the standard area cleaning, for robots whose integration does not support it. Variables: room, area_id, work_mode, pass_id, quiet, vacuum_entity.
